name: rheon-head
description: The first N Flux records -- head for records, keeping the terminator rule.
notes:
The first N Flux records -- head for records. Unlike plain head it keeps the terminator rule: when it cut the stream it ends with head-stats:truncated (not complete, since it never saw upstream finish) and says so on stderr; when it did not cut, it passes completion on. Reads at most two records past N, then stops.

Prototype for #62 (2026-10-13); promoted to Rust in #78 (2026-10-14), with the Python version kept as the diff-test reference. Short names fhead / ftail (decided 2026-10-14, matching fsort / fcount): the npm packages of the same names only collide for someone who installs them globally -- the #57 shape.
